description:
The Cheese Heist:
You, the player, will control a mouse, and your goal is to collect all the cheese (yellow objects) in the map and escape the cats (enemy) for as long as you can. There will be speed potions (purple objects) that the mouse and enemy can collect to temporarily increase its speed, and catnip that the mouse can collect and shoot at the cat to make the enemies stop in their tracks for 3 seconds. The key player experiences goals include using strategic and quick thinking to navigate the map without colliding with the enemy, and players should feel a sense of tension, excitement and thrill whilst playing this game.
